title: Higher direct images of an injective module sheaf vanish
statement: Let $p:X\to S$ be a morphism of schemes, let $R$ be a commutative ring, and let $I$ be an injective object of the category $\Mod(X_{\Et},R)$ of sheaves of $R_X$-modules on the small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves]. Then the higher direct images of the underlying sheaf of abelian groups vanish: $R^qp_*I=0$ in $\Ab(S_{\Et})$ for every $q>0$, where $R^qp_*$ is the higher direct image of abelian sheaves [def-weil-pbc-direct-image].

source.place: Lemma Tag 03FD (lemma-cohomology-modules-abelian-agree): $H^q(U,I_{ab})=H^q(U,I)$, which is $0$ for $q>0$ because the restriction of an injective module to $U$ is injective; Lemma Tag 072W (lemma-higher-direct-images): $R^qp_*I$ is the sheafification of $V\mapsto H^q(X\times_SV,I)$
